The Semester Grade Point Average (SGPA) is calculated using the following formula:

**SGPA = Sum(Credit_Hours * Grade_Points) / Sum(Credit_Hours)**

This represents the sum of the products of credit hours and grade points divided by the total credit hours registered in the semester.
